svg.title: Mingyun Chae — Founder of TriAstra
svg.desc: Founder of TriAstra. Senior Backend & AI Agent Platform Engineer. 1,051 repository-wide merged PRs, September 19–October 18, 2026 UTC, all authors including bots. Approximately 10 AI agent role sessions and 100+ peak concurrent OMP coding agents; excludes Aside. Seven merged upstream PRs, four hackathon first places, and US and Korean patent registrations. Snapshot: October 18, 2026; agent figures approximate from OMP logs.
